> **OMAC 控制的执行。第一动作必须严格执行：**

```bash
OMAC_ENGINE=multica OMAC_WORKSPACE_ID=410ade5e-8ae0-4402-b975-813dea2ff3e1 OMAC_PROJECT_ID=732ce83f-5cbd-4485-850d-1b8a1bf16340 omac work show 01a1048e-0327-70a5-84b8-d2967af606ea --output json
```

> `omac work show` 和 `omac work submit` 都可能长时间运行。任何工具调用在拿到最终 tool_result 和终态退出码前都不完整。若工具返回 running/session、缺少最终 tool_result、出现空输出或不完整输出，必须等待或轮询到终态。使用足够长的 wait/yield，或保留并恢复续接句柄；这是通用终态规则，不绑定某个具体工具 API。timeout/yield 不是空结果，也不允许据此停止。`omac work show` 只有在退出码 0 且得到可解析 JSON 后才能继续。`omac work submit` 只有在最终 tool_result 明确给出退出码 0，且 JSON 包含 `"ok": true`、`"terminal": true` 和 `"next_action": "stop"` 时才可宣称成功。结果未知时不得宣称成功或结束；validation error 必须修复后重新提交。submit 成功就是本次执行的最后动作，立即停止，不再执行任何平台写入。

> 在上方精确的 `omac work show` 命令以退出码 0 成功返回可解析 JSON 前，不得执行任何其他 Issue 查询（包括 `multica issue get`、`multica issue comment list` 或 metadata 查询），也不得开始分析任务内容。work show 成功后，只能在返回上下文确有需要时使用只读 Issue 查询。禁止任何会创建、修改或删除 Issue 状态的 `multica issue` 写操作。这是语义边界，不是穷举命令清单；禁止示例包括 `multica issue status`、`multica issue assign`、`multica issue comment`、`multica issue metadata`、`multica issue rerun`、`multica issue cancel-task`、`multica issue update`、`multica issue create`、`multica issue label`、`multica issue property`、`multica issue reorder` 和 `multica issue subscriber`。只允许使用上方给出的精确 `omac work show` 命令，以及 work show 返回的精确 `omac work submit` 命令作为 OMAC 控制命令；已有手工附件或 verification 但缺少 `delivery_identity` 时也必须通过该 submit 命令封存。

# Implement Agent Platform API

## 任务摘要
- 类型: 开发实现（`develop`）
- 执行角色: 开发执行者（`worker`）
- 目标: Expose AgentTemplate, model policy and AgentDefinition lifecycle operations without adapter-owned business state.
- 依据: `docs/design/detailed/10-web-api-cli-detailed-design.md:L1392-L1428`
- 依据: `docs/design/detailed/10-web-api-cli-detailed-design.md:L355-L638`
- 依据: `docs/design/detailed/10-web-api-cli-detailed-design.md:L1375-L1545`

## 任务详情
Definition-only topology and artifact-consumer correction for an unstarted node. Replace the completed historical agent-definition predecessor with its owner-approved audit consumer adaptation, then use the checked-in package_component.py generated-input contract to digest-bind the three exact upstream component manifests and both owned API source roots into the four declared api-agent artifacts. The matching verifier checks the exact output bundle, component identity, owned roots, generated inputs, and ownership closure. No work item or runtime evidence exists, so no resume stage is requested.

## 非目标
- Do not change adjacent domain ownership or introduce a competing source of truth.
- Do not bypass authorization, admission, CAS, idempotency, review or evidence gates.
- Do not preserve unpublished prototype behavior unless the owning design explicitly requires it.

## 主要代码归属范围
- `api/openapi/agents/**`
- `internal/httpapi/agents/**`

## 交付约束
- PR 基线: `main`
- 改动分支覆盖率: `≥ 90%`
- PR 关联标识: `AITEAM-1069`

review_obligations.requirement: Ownership, boundaries, and unique write paths
Prior blocker regression and changed-scope review

blocker_facts.summary: Published command schemas do not specify the required governance and actual failure outcomes.
blocker_facts.evidence: docs/design/detailed/10-web-api-cli-detailed-design.md:1398-1409 requires each command to define RequestContext, authorization action, Admission boundary, business refusal, conflict, retryable/nonretryable errors and audit semantics. api/openapi/agents/openapi.yaml:169-225 declares only 200/409 for each lifecycle command, despite handler.go:80-83 returning 403 for missing governance context, :216-220 returning 400, and :318-331 mapping 404/403/503/500. The document has no security scheme/security requirement and lifecycle operations contain no authorization, Admission or audit contract. Its Conflict response at :259-263 combines CAS, idempotency and protected-reference conflicts, while handler.go:324-325 provides the same refresh-and-retry message for all of them. Publication describes governance generically at openapi.yaml:106-111 but does not define its authorization action or retry semantics.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Complete the authoritative OpenAPI command contracts with the supported authenticated RequestContext transport, authorization actions, Admission applicability and audit semantics (link the owning governance contract where appropriate). Declare every supported HTTP failure or a typed default error response, including lifecycle 400/403/404/503/internal failures. Preserve safe machine-readable distinctions and next actions for stale revision, idempotency mismatch and protected-reference/business refusal. Add schema/HTTP conformance checks to the existing declared suite instead of testing only spec substring presence.

blocker_facts.summary: HTTP operations have no production bridge to the owning Agent application use cases.
blocker_facts.evidence: internal/httpapi/agents/handler.go:50-65 introduces a 10-method Application interface taking API-owned DTOs; handler.go:71-73 only injects it. Repository-wide symbol searches find its methods implemented solely in handler_test.go:503-572 and all constructor uses in tests. Actual templates.Application.Instantiate at internal/agents/templates/templates.go:120 takes templates.InstantiateRequest, whereas definitions.Application.PublishBlank at internal/agents/definitions/definitions.go:332 takes PublishBlankRequest with RequestContextID, an existing Agent/CAS and already-resolved runtime bindings. No production code translates the public request, calculates instruction digests, resolves runtime requests/defaults, preserves template provenance, or bridges catalog/lifecycle calls. Publication/lifecycle tests at handler_test.go:130-225,263-284 return fabricated test results rather than exercising these owner boundaries; only template test closures at :60-65,:91-95 invoke an actual upstream application.
blocker_facts.required_fix: Supply production transport-to-owner composition using the actual inward-facing use-case contracts (or explicitly resolve an owner-contract prerequisite through the authorized process). Translate the public inputs/results and safe classified failures; derive server-owned values at the owning application boundary; preserve RequestContext/audit provenance, CAS/idempotency, template provenance and reference protection. Do not add business state or lifecycle rules in the HTTP adapter and do not force inner application modules to import API DTOs. Extend the declared package suite to exercise this production bridge with deterministic owner-port fixtures, including template and blank publication and lifecycle refusal paths.

blocker.summary: The Agent API needs owner use cases missing from this repository; implementing their rules in HTTP would duplicate domain behavior.
blocker.decision_needed: Identify Project & Team owner contracts/composition for Agent creation, blank/template publication, queries, policy resolution, and archive/restore/delete. Specify RequestContext ID and typed safe errors; preserve governance, preflight, CAS/idempotency, template provenance, and deletion reference checks.

evidence.observation: templates.Application returns a snapshot only; PublishBlank requires an existing Agent/revision and RequestContextID. AgentCatalog only reads; no create or template-publish command exists.

evidence.ref: PR #105 f0987a71; internal/projects/lifecycle/lifecycle.go; repository symbol search
evidence.observation: Project lifecycle handles Project setup. No Agent archive/restore/delete use case exists outside this API adapter.
modelpolicy.Resolve is pure and takes caller-supplied catalogs/probes; no owner command loads or rechecks them.
The owner requires active Workflows/AgentRuns to survive archive and deletion to atomically reject retained references.
